boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission outdoor activities at nearby Swatara State Park, using documented trails, waterways, and historic features.

cards.title: Walk the Swatara Rail Trail
cards.subtitle: Swatara State Park, north of Annville
cards.notes: Bring water, choose a turnaround point together, and use the park map before heading out on the former rail corridor.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission group walk on Swatara State Park’s named rail trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; DCNR identifies the Swatara Rail Trail at Swatara State Park.
cards.access_notes: Swatara State Park is open daily, sunrise to sunset; day-use areas close at dusk.

cards.title: Ride the Bear Hole Trail
cards.subtitle: Swatara State Park, north of Annville
cards.notes: Plan a daylight bike ride on the named Bear Hole Trail and check the park map for route conditions before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A bring-your-own-bike outing on a documented Swatara trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; DCNR identifies Bear Hole Trail as a bike ride at Swatara State Park.
cards.access_notes: Use a personal bike and visit during the park’s daily sunrise-to-sunset hours.

cards.title: Loop the Northern Multi-use Trail
cards.subtitle: Swatara State Park, north of Annville
cards.notes: Use the official map to locate the Northern Multi-use Loop, then set a relaxed group pace and stay on marked routes.
cards.short_summary: A mapped loop ride for a daytime outdoor hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; DCNR lists the Northern Multi-use Loop among Swatara State Park rides.
cards.access_notes: Use a personal bike and visit during the park’s daily sunrise-to-sunset hours.

cards.title: Loop the Southern Multi-use Trail
cards.subtitle: Swatara State Park, north of Annville
cards.notes: Choose the Southern Multi-use Loop from the park guide, ride with a buddy, and leave enough time to return before dusk.
cards.short_summary: A distinct documented loop ride in the state park.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; DCNR lists the Southern Multi-use Loop among Swatara State Park rides.
cards.access_notes: Use a personal bike and visit during the park’s daily sunrise-to-sunset hours.

cards.title: Watch Wildlife Along Swatara Creek
cards.subtitle: Swatara State Park, north of Annville
cards.notes: Pause along the creek corridor to look and listen for wildlife; keep a respectful distance and pack out all trash.
cards.short_summary: A low-key creekside nature watch in a documented wetland landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; DCNR lists wildlife watching at Swatara State Park.
cards.access_notes: The park is open every day, sunrise to sunset; day-use areas close at dusk.

cards.title: Find the Union Canal Lock Remains
cards.subtitle: Swatara State Park, north of Annville
cards.notes: Use DCNR’s Union Canal map to locate visible lock remains, then photograph from established paths without climbing on ruins.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided look at documented remnants of the Union Canal.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; DCNR documents visible Union Canal lock remains in Swatara State Park.
cards.access_notes: Visit in daylight during the park’s daily sunrise-to-sunset operating window.

cards.title: Spot the Union Canal Towpath Bridge
cards.subtitle: Swatara State Park, north of Annville
cards.notes: Follow the official canal map with friends and view the historic towpath bridge from permitted trail areas only.
cards.short_summary: A history-focused walk to a documented canal-era feature.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; DCNR documents a surviving Union Canal towpath bridge in Swatara State Park.
cards.access_notes: Visit in daylight during the park’s daily sunrise-to-sunset operating window.

cards.title: Walk to Waterville Bridge
cards.subtitle: Swatara State Park, north of Annville
cards.notes: Make the bridge your shared destination, keep to the marked route, and give yourself time to return before day-use closes.
cards.short_summary: A destination walk to Swatara’s relocated historic truss bridge.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; DCNR documents Waterville Bridge as a rebuilt crossing in Swatara State Park.
cards.access_notes: The park is open every day, sunrise to sunset; day-use areas close at dusk.

cards.title: Trace the Canal’s Dam Sites
cards.subtitle: Swatara State Park, north of Annville
cards.notes: Use the Union Canal map to orient your walk and discuss the waterway’s history while staying on public, established routes.
cards.short_summary: A map-led outdoor history activity around documented canal dams.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; DCNR documents three remaining Union Canal dams in Swatara State Park.
cards.access_notes: Visit in daylight during the park’s daily sunrise-to-sunset operating window.

cards.title: Pack a Creekside Picnic Break
cards.subtitle: Swatara State Park, north of Annville
cards.notes: Bring food from home, choose a lawful day-use stop near the creek, and carry every scrap back out with your group.
cards.short_summary: A bring-your-own-food outdoor pause beside Swatara Creek.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; DCNR identifies Swatara Creek as running through Swatara State Park.
cards.access_notes: The park uses carry-in/carryout disposal; visit daily from sunrise to sunset.
